Back up and restore Home layout and settings

Included: 12/20-cell choice, Home pages and order, folders, app and shortcut positions, Home settings, selected theme, app names, custom icons, and icon redirects. Not included: wallpaper, APKs or app data, signed-in accounts, system permissions, default Home status, privacy password, weather cache, or location data. Restore does not install missing apps or change the current wallpaper. Backup files may contain app names; keep them safe.

Restore replaces the current Home layout and backed-up Home settings. Current new apps and valid shortcuts are kept at the end of Home. The current state is saved automatically and can be undone. Wallpaper is not changed.
